items.summary: In the Patient Registry workflow, provide a Prescriber Details section for the selected patient with fields: Prefix (dropdown), Full Name, Registration Number, Address, Mail ID (email), Contact Number, and Specialization, and ensure it is reachable from the Patient Registry tab without leaving the patient context.

Update the Prescriber prefix dropdown labeling so the user-facing value for PrescriberPrefix.practitionerNurse is "Practitioner Nurse" (not "Nurse"), and ensure all user-facing text is correctly spelled and consistent across the Prescriber Details UI and Case Summary.

Implement backend support for saving and retrieving prescriber details per patient, including: (1) a query method to get prescriber details by patientId, and (2) an update method to save/replace prescriber details for a patientId, performing validation consistent with backend validation rules.

Persist prescriber details across canister upgrades by adding stable storage for the prescriber details map keyed by patientId, and add a conditional migration if required by the existing state layout.

Review and update the drug dataset so the complete drug list is up to date and includes missing entries as needed, ensuring every drug record includes at minimum: name, status (approved/banned), date, category (when known), description, source, and safetyInfo.

Add/ensure a post-refresh drug verification workflow exists that checks that drug list additions/updates were applied correctly (e.g., deduplication, required-field completeness, counts), and expose the latest verification result to the UI.

Perform an application review focused on Patient Registry + Drug Database screens and fix any issues that prevent the full datasets (patients/drugs) from loading and being usable (e.g., missing queries, partial rendering, broken filters/pagination), without introducing unrelated features.
